question: Can I still watch Gossip Girl series?

answers: Yes, you can still watch Gossip Girl series. Episodes of Gossip Girl have been released on the Internet and are available through various platforms such as Netflix, Hulu, iTunes Store, and Amazon Video. Both CWTV.com and Hulu streamed episodes for free, but only the five most recent installments were available for viewing. All seasons of Gossip Girl are also available through the iTunes Store and Amazon Video where each episode can be purchased separately or in complete season sets.

history.content: where do the humphreys live in gossip girl
The Humphreys live in Brooklyn, New York, in the Gossip Girl series. However, they moved to the Upper East Side after Rufus Humphrey, the father of Dan and Jenny, married Lily van der Woodsen.
What is the plot of Gossip Girl series/

The Gossip Girl series based on the book series of the same name written by Cecily von Ziegesar . The series , created by Josh Schwartz and Stephanie Savage, revolves around the fictional lives of privileged upper - class Caucasian adolescents living in Manhattan 's Upper East Side .

The major characters of the Gossip Girl series include Dan Humphrey, Serena van der Woodsen, Blair Waldorf, Chuck Bass, Nate Archibald, primary male character,  portrayed by Chace Crawfords ,  Jenny Humphrey, portrayed by Taylor Momsen and Vanessa Abrams, played by Jessica Szohr,Juliet Sharp portrayed bt Katie Cassidy.
Who play Serena van der Woodsen?
I do not have information on who played Serena van der Woodsenin the Gossip Girl series.
Did the series get any awards?

Yes, the Gossip Girl series received numerous award nominations , winning 18 Teen Choice Awards .  2008 Nominated Artios Award Outstanding Achievement in Casting; Blake Lively  Won Teen Choice Awards Choice TV 2008 and many others.Gossip Girl was considered the Greatest Teen Drama of All Time '' by New York magazine .
Was it adapted in other countries?

Yes, the success of Gossip Girl led to adaptations outside the United States . The Turkish version is known as Küçük Sırlar (Little Secrets), and there was a plan to produce a Chinese teen drama series called China Girl inspired by Gossip Girl. Additionally, an adaptation aired in Thailand on Channel 3 beginning July 16, 2015, dubbed as Gossip Girl: Thailand.

Gossip Girl Day was proclaimed by New York City Mayor Michael Bloomberg on January 26, 2012, in honor of the series' 100th episode. The proclamation highlighted the show's cultural influence and impact on the city's economy, as it attracts many fans to visit New York and contributes to the tourism industry.
